subject_definitions:

Reference Image 1:
A 20-year-old handsome Asian male office worker.
The protagonist identity reference.
Maintain the same face shape, facial features, hairstyle, age, body proportion, and modern professional outfit throughout the entire video.
He is the main character experiencing the time travel event.

Reference Image 2:
A realistic modern office elevator interior.
Maintain the exact elevator design, button panel layout, materials, lighting, and spatial structure.
The elevator contains floor buttons from 1 to 28 and a special horizontal "8" infinity symbol button (∞).
The infinity button is the key story object and must remain visually consistent.

Reference Image 3:
A 19-year-old young Asian professional woman.
Maintain the same face, hairstyle, youthful appearance, body shape, white shirt, short skirt, and pure fashionable office style throughout the video.
She is the female character appearing after the time travel.

Reference Image 4:
A realistic Han Dynasty ancient street environment.
Includes ancient shops, wooden buildings, pedestrians, horse carriages, horse riders, street vendors, and authentic historical daily life atmosphere.

summary:

Create a 15-second cinematic ultra-realistic time travel short film.
A modern young male office worker from Reference Image 1 enters the elevator from Reference Image 2, discovers and presses the mysterious horizontal "8" infinity button, travels through time, exits into the Han Dynasty street from Reference Image 4, walks forward two steps, and unexpectedly sees the woman from Reference Image 3 walking toward him.
The video should feel like a high-budget realistic movie scene with strong contrast between modern technology and ancient history.

retention_analysis:

Maintain strict identity consistency:

* Reference Image 1 male character must keep the exact same face, hairstyle, age, body proportions, and clothing in every shot.
* Reference Image 3 female character must keep the exact same face, hairstyle, age, body proportions, and white shirt plus short skirt outfit when appearing.
* Reference Image 2 elevator must preserve the exact button arrangement and especially the horizontal "8" infinity symbol button.
* Reference Image 4 Han Dynasty street must preserve realistic historical architecture, clothing of ancient people, vehicles, and atmosphere.

Important visual continuity:

* The male character's right hand must clearly press the horizontal 8 (∞) button.
* After time travel, the male character must physically walk forward exactly two steps before seeing the woman.
* The woman must also move toward the male character after noticing him.
* Their meeting must feel like an emotional cinematic coincidence.

detailed_description:

0-3 seconds:

Opening shot.
A modern office building corridor.

The male character from Reference Image 1 enters the elevator from Reference Image 2.

Camera:
Cinematic tracking shot following him into the elevator.

Inside the elevator:
The man stands in front of the control panel.
He prepares to select a floor.

Show:
Modern elevator interior.
Button panel.
Professional office atmosphere.

3-6 seconds:

Close-up sequence.

Camera moves into an extreme close-up of the elevator buttons.

The male character notices a strange button:
a horizontal number 8 infinity symbol (∞).

He looks surprised and curious.

Critical action:
The male character raises his right hand.
His right index finger clearly presses the horizontal 8 (∞) button.

Show clearly:

* Finger touching the infinity button.
* Button illumination.
* Elevator lights flickering.
* Subtle realistic spatial distortion.

The effect should be cinematic and realistic.
No exaggerated science fiction effects.

6-9 seconds:

Time travel transition.

Inside the elevator:
The lights stabilize.

The elevator doors slowly open.

Instead of a modern office building,
the door reveals the Han Dynasty street from Reference Image 4.

The male character steps outside.

Camera follows behind him.

He looks around in shock.

Show:

* Ancient shops.
* Crowded streets.
* Horse carriages passing.
* Horse riders.
* People walking.
* Real historical daily life.

Create a strong visual contrast:
modern office worker inside ancient China.

9-12 seconds:

Discovery scene.

The male character walks forward.

Important movement:
After leaving the elevator,
he walks forward exactly two steps.

Step one:
He observes the unfamiliar ancient street.

Step two:
He suddenly notices someone familiar.

Camera switches to his point of view.

In the crowd,
he sees the female character from Reference Image 3.

She is wearing the same modern white shirt and short skirt outfit,
standing in the middle of the Han Dynasty street.

The man's expression changes from curiosity to shock and disbelief.

12-15 seconds:

Emotional climax.

The woman notices the man.

She recognizes him.

The woman starts walking toward him.

At the same time,
the male character walks slowly toward her.

They move closer through the ancient street.

A horse carriage passes between them,
temporarily blocking their view.

After the carriage leaves,
they see each other again.

Camera:
Slow cinematic push-in.
Shallow depth of field.
The camera must obtain a clear, unobstructed close-up of the woman's face, matching Reference Image 3 exactly.

Final frame:
The two modern people stand together in the center of a Han Dynasty street,
surrounded by ancient architecture and crowds.

A mysterious emotional reunion between two eras.

overall_soundscape:

Realistic cinematic environment sounds:

* Elevator button click.
* Elevator mechanical hum.
* Soft electronic elevator sounds.
* Subtle energy distortion sound during time travel.
* Ancient marketplace atmosphere.
* Footsteps on stone street.
* Horse footsteps.
* Wooden carriage wheels.
* Crowd conversations.
* Street vendors calling.
* Natural city ambience.

No artificial futuristic sounds.

non_diegetic_music:

Cinematic orchestral background music.

Beginning:
Minimal modern suspense atmosphere.

During infinity button press:
Music builds with mysterious tension.

During time travel:
Slow dramatic rise.

During the reunion:
Emotional cinematic strings.

Ending:
A powerful but subtle emotional resolution.

No lyrics.
No narration.
No subtitles.
No watermark.
